look_here_first: Use the erect dark purple-green to reddish-black stem together with oblong to oblanceolate coarsely serrate leaves and the very small terminal or leaf-opposed raceme. Confirm with flower counts, pedicel bases, and capsule size rather than stem color alone.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: erect stems purple-green to reddish black, apex not flexuous

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: oblong to oblanceolate leaves with coarse serration

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: persistent staminate pedicel bases about 0.2–0.4 mm

lookalikes.differences: Dark erect stems help, but leaf base, raceme structure, flower count, pedicel bases, and mature capsule are required for confident separation.
